@图片1 为女医生，@图片2 为男患者A，@图片3为男患者B，@图片4 诊室场景，根据我的参考图帮我写一段关于医生与患者之间的幽默对话。

Audio mapping rule：
<Audio 1> = <Subject 1> 医生
<Audio 2> = <Subject 3> 患者 B
<Audio 3> = <Subject 2> 患者 A

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female doctor from the uploaded reference image. He appearance and clothing should be consistent with the reference image: middle-aged woman with short curly black hair, wearing a bright magenta-pink puffer jacket, black trousers, black shoes, and a yellow lanyard with a doctor ID badge around her neck. She may also wear a dark inner shirt underneath. This outfit remains consistent throughout the video.
<Subject 2> is male patient A, an original middle-aged male patient.
<Subject 3> is male patient B, an original middle-aged male patient.
<Subject 4> is a clean bright clinic consultation-room environment.

summary:
The target video is a 15-second short humorous clinic exchange set in a consultation room, where the female doctor talks one-on-one with patient A first, then patient B joins the conversation. The female doctor has independent dialogue interactions with both patients. Two men with opposite physical troubles consult the doctor; they envy each other’s figure, and the doctor responds to each of them respectively with witty lines, creating a funny daily medical sitcom.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]. Her identity as a consulting physician, short curly black hair, bright magenta-pink puffer jacket, black trousers, yellow lanyard and ID badge are retained and consistent throughout the video.
<Subject 2> appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4] as male patient A.
<Subject 3> appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4] as male patient B.
<Subject 4> appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4] as a continuous clinic consultation-room setting.

detailed_description:
Clean, bright medical sitcom style, soft overhead clinic lighting, lightly desaturated color palette, realistic but slightly comedic daily performance.

[Shot 1] 00:00–00:04.500
Medium wide shot inside the consultation room. The female doctor sits behind the desk facing forward, pen resting over a medical chart. She wears the bright magenta-pink puffer jacket, black trousers, yellow lanyard and ID badge, consistent with the reference image. Male patient A sits on the visitor chair across the desk, looking weary. Male patient B sits quietly on the waiting chair beside the wall.

<Subject 1><Audio 1> calmly asks in Chinese: 哪里不舒服？
<Subject 2><Audio 3> leans forward with a distressed look and says in Chinese: 医生，我最近浑身发沉，稍微一动就累，管不住嘴还不爱动，身上肉越来越多。
<Subject 1><Audio 1> nods and replies in Chinese: 简单来说，就是摄入大于消耗，肥肉长期 “定居” 在你身上了。

[Shot 2] 00:04.500–00:08.200
Camera pans slightly toward the waiting area. Patient B leans forward and speaks to the female doctor.

<Subject 3><Audio 2> says in Chinese: 医生，我也想问问，我跟他正好相反，吃再多也不长肉，经常体虚没劲。
<Subject 1><Audio 1> turns her gaze toward patient B and replies in Chinese: 你属于营养吸收偏弱，养分只是路过身体，没法留下来储备。

[Shot 3] 00:08.200–00:11.600
Medium group shot. Patient A turns to look at patient B and sighs.

<Subject 2><Audio 3> says in Chinese: 真羡慕你这种怎么吃都不胖的体质，要不咱俩互相匀点肉？
<Subject 3><Audio 2> chuckles and responds in Chinese: 我还想分你点力气呢。

[Shot 4] 00:11.600–00:15.000
Medium close-up focus on the female doctor. She gently taps her pen on the medical chart, holds back laughter, and maintains her magenta-pink puffer jacket, yellow lanyard and doctor ID badge.

<Subject 1><Audio 1> says in Chinese: 两位这个资源互换的想法很有创意，但是目前医学上还没有这种人肉调剂的办法。胖有胖的调理方式，瘦有瘦的改善方案，都得管住生活习惯。

Patient A and patient B glance at each other, scratch their heads awkwardly and smile wryly. The female doctor reveals a faint amused smile and begins sorting medical documents helplessly.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet consultation room, faint air conditioner hum, soft pen and paper rustling, no noisy background.

non_diegetic_music:
Gentle pizzicato strings sitcom background music, volume lower than dialogue, short playful musical sting after the last line.
